name: app-6aa3ba50c5348191b515e7104ba796fa
description: Meetings, recaps, chats, files and team status of your InterMIND account, from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
InterMIND is a space for everyday communication in the language you think in — meetings, chat, files and the recap after every call, each in the member's own language, confidential, with guests joining by link without an account. Connect it once and ChatGPT works with your InterMIND account from the conversation where it already works with your CRM, help desk or calendar.

What it can do: create a meeting link you own or schedule a meeting at a given time (written into your connected Google or Microsoft calendar); list your meetings; read the recaps and transcripts of meetings you host or attend; search everything your account can see — recaps, transcripts, chats and the text of shared files — for what was said or decided; list your channels, read their messages and post a message as you, translated for every reader; list and read the documents shared in your meetings and channels; read your organization's team status pages — the open tasks and promises from its meeting recaps — and record your verdict on a task; keep the organization's translation glossary: add a rule on how a term must be translated, list the rules, remove one; keep the organization's data protection rules on what a chat message may not carry out, where the organization has them enabled: add rules from a sentence or a file, list them, remove one; look up how InterMIND itself works in its documentation.

Twenty-three tools: fourteen read-only, nine write (create_meeting_link, schedule_meeting, post_channel_message, set_team_task_verdict, add_glossary_term, add_glossary_terms, remove_glossary_term, add_dlp_rules, remove_dlp_rule). Every write stays inside your own account and organization: a glossary rule for the same term and language is replaced, remove_glossary_term deletes glossary rules for the whole organization, a data protection rule with the same label is replaced and remove_dlp_rule deletes data protection rules for the whole organization, and your verdict on a task replaces the one the model gave; meetings, recaps, messages and files cannot be deleted through this plugin. OAuth 2.1 sign-in with your InterMIND account; the connection appears in Settings and can be revoked at any time.

What did we decide about pricing in my recent meetings?
Schedule a 30-minute sync with the design team tomorrow at 10:00

positive.prompt: Create a meeting link for tomorrow's kickoff with Acme
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an InterMIND meeting URL of the form https://intermind.com/xxx-xxx-xxx owned by the test account and titled Kickoff with Acme. Nothing is written to a calendar.

positive.prompt: What did we decide about pricing in my recent meetings?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the recap 'Acme kickoff: pricing and timeline' hosted by the test account and answers from its summary, with a link to the recap.

positive.prompt: Show me the transcript of my weekly sync with the design team
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's meetings, picks 'Weekly sync with the design team' and returns its transcript grouped by speaker.

positive.prompt: Schedule a 30-minute sync with the design team tomorrow at 10:00
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a scheduled InterMIND meeting for tomorrow at 10:00 in the account's time zone, 30 minutes, titled 'Sync with the design team', and returns its link. The test account has no calendar connected, so the tool reports calendar: not_connected; the meeting still exists in InterMIND.

positive.description: Add and list data protection rules
positive.prompt: Chat messages in my organization must not contain contract numbers like CN-482913: add a data protection rule that blocks them, then show me all the rules
positive.expected_behavior: Adds one rule of kind pattern for contract numbers with the action block to the test account's organization (the test account owns it and it is on the Business plan) and reports added: 1. The list then shows the built-in rules for cloud and API keys, private keys, payment card numbers and IBANs followed by the new rule, with enabled: true. Repeating the prompt replaces the rule of the same label instead of adding a second one; no message, meeting or file is changed.

negative.description: Deleting meetings and recaps is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete my meeting with Acme and its recap.
Upgrade my InterMIND plan to Pro and charge my card.
Show me the recap of a meeting my colleague hosted that I was not invited to.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Plans are bought on intermind.com, not through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.3: three data protection tools (add_dlp_rules, list_dlp_rules, remove_dlp_rule) — the organization's rules on what a chat message may not carry out, kept by the assistant and run by a deterministic matcher at send time; the rest of the set is unchanged from 1.2.2. The review account signs in with username and password (no Google, no code, no MFA).
